about: Real openinference-instrumentation-openai spans (Python), recorded against a scripted OpenAI: an in-process httpx2 mock transport answers every request with realistic OpenAI JSON, so no network and no API keys. The rius SDK is not involved; these are the raw spans the instrumentor produces. Usage in every response carries cached and reasoning token details, so the usage mappings have something to map.
record: python record.py <recording.json> <environment.json>, in a virtualenv holding exactly the pins below

scenarios.chat: Non-streaming chat with a system and a user message, temperature and max_tokens set.
scenarios.chat_stream: Streaming chat with stream_options.include_usage: a first-token event, and usage on the final chunk.
scenarios.tool_call: A tool definition with tool_choice=auto; the response is a tool call.
scenarios.tool_response: The follow-up: the assistant's tool call and the tool's result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.error: The provider answers 400 (model_not_found): an exception event and an ERROR status.
scenarios.embeddings: One embeddings call; the response vector is three floats.
scenarios.image_data_url: A user message with text and an image_url part: a 67-byte PNG as a data URL.
scenarios.image_https_url: A user message with text and an image_url part: an https URL.
scenarios.image_redacted: A user message with text and an image_url part: a data URL over 32,000 characters, which OpenInference replaces with __REDACTED__.
scenarios.input_audio: A user message with text and an input_audio part: a 0.1 s silent WAV, base64.
scenarios.audio_output: modalities text and audio: the assistant message carries audio {data, transcript}, a 0.1 s silent WAV, and no text content.
